text: Ice Shards is the Frost mage secondary stat attunement, focusing on Multistrike.
Ice Floes is a mage talent located on tier 6 of the Frost tree.
Ian Gerdes is a human located next to Scott Smith in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Ian was a soldier under Lorena. He accompanied Lorena and her army out of Northwatch. They were attacked by orcish members of the Burning Blade clan, but he did not survived the encounter.
Ian Jolly is a human located at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest. He seems to be the new owner of the farm.
Ice Nine is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Let It Go and Shield of Alodi traits.
Ice Age is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Clarity of Thought and Chilled to the Core (mage artifact trait) traits.
Ian Glassel is a human located at the Timbered Strand in Drustvar.
Icarius is a night elf located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
Ilifar is a level 60 human death knight summoned by Razelikh in the Blasted Lands.

Ielephia was a female half-elf rogue in life. Now she is a banshee of the Scourge. This creature appears to be a half-elf clad in leathers. However, her body is tranlucent and floats upon the air with no regard for the ground below her feet. She still is capable of speaking several languages (Common, Elven, Gnomish, and Ignan). However, she is enigmatic, speaking in riddles and refusing to answer direct questions, but her loyalty to the Lich King seems unquestionable.

Iggy Darktusk is a troll member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Troll death knights have a chance to execute Darktusk.

Ikaneba Summerset is a night elf Pilgrim's Bounty Vendor available during the Pilgrim's Bounty event. She is located in Darnassus at the Pilgrim's Bounty feast tables and is dressed in what looks like a traditional Native American outfit.
Ilaniel Pine is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Ignore Pain is a warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Storm Wall for Arms.
Il'zolgar is a fel lord that appears at Legion Invasion locations.
Il'drethal is a fel lord located at Legion Invasion locations.

Idra'zuul is a fel lord who first appeared in the Hillsbrad Foothills and Tanaris during the Legion Invasions in the pre-patch. He was also among the demons that attacked Dalaran when it was above Deadwind Pass. Now, Idra'zuul can be summoned to the Fel Hammer and Dreadscar Rift via the Twisting Nether and Demonic Offering order advancements, respectively. He also appears at the Stony Highlands in Stormheim during Legion Assaults.
Icy Caress is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Frozen Veins, Icy Hand and Orbital Strike (artifact trait) traits.
Icy Hand is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Clarity of Thought and Icy Caress traits.
Idras Proudwing is a night elf druid located in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore.
Ijap is a tuskarr he is sleighing on a small isle west of the Azure Archives in the Azure Span.
Illestria Bladesinger is a night elf found at the Silver Covenant Pavilion in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown as part of the Argent Tournament. She was present during Death Rising.
Illusionist Karina is a human located under the Violet Citadel in the Underbelly. She can provide directions for various locations in the Underbelly.
Ilsa Direbrew is a Dark Iron dwarf that spawns alongside Ursula Direbrew in the Grim Guzzler, inside Blackrock Depths, when Coren Direbrew is engaged in a fight and reaches 35% of health.
Ilyanna Talongrasp is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Illusionist Hartin is a human found outside the wall of Dalaran looking down over the Broken Isles.
Illidari Starr is a night elven demon hunter of the Illidari located in Illidari Foothold on Mardum.
Illidari Kilbride is a blood elf demon hunter of the Illidari located in Illidari Foothold on Mardum.
Illidan's Grasp is a Vengeance demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Illidari Knowledge is a Havoc demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Contained Fury and Rage of the Illidari traits.
Illnea Bloodthorn is a level 110 blood elf demon hunter who will trade trade goods or a cache of Order Resources for Blood of Sargeras. She is found in the Magus Commerce Exchange in Dalaran.
Ilthara Darkthorn is a night elf located at the Veiled Den in the Antoran Wastes.
Illenya is a night elf located in the Coliseum of Highmaul watching the fights between garrison commanders.
Ascending Flame is a Vengeance demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Down in Flames
Improved Arcane Shot is a hunter talent located on tier 3 of the Marksmanship tree.
Imnek is a tuskarr and a general goods vendor located at Moa'ki Harbor in the Dragonblight.
Impending Victory is a warrior talent. It replaces Victory Rush.
Imme Ironheart is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Imperator Molok was the sorcerer king of the Gorian Empire roughly 400 years before the opening of the Dark Portal. His tampering with the elementals and the Throne of the Elements led to a war between the orcs and the ogres that ended with the complete destruction of the ogre capital, Goria.

Imperator Kelgrok was the ruler of the Bladespire ogres of Bladespire Hold roughly 11 years before the opening of the Dark Portal. In an attempt to maintain the ogres' waning grip on Frostfire Ridge, he oversaw the creation of an army of half-ogre, half-orc halfbreeds known as the mok'nathal. He was eventually killed by one of his own creations, the mok'nathal elder Leoroxx, during the Battle of Bladespire.
Immobius was a storm dragon located at the Oculus in Coldarra. He was taken out by the mage champions of the Tirisgarde when they where preparing to assault the Oculus.
Imperator Deconix is a fel lord located at the Gaze of the Legion in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
Immaterial Huntsman is a human located in the Lost Estate in Stormsong Valley.
Improved Frostbolt is a mage talent located on tier 1 of the Frost tree. It reduces casting time of the Frostbolt spell by 0.1 seconds per rank, up to 0.5 seconds at rank 5.

Improved Frost Ward was a mage talent that caused Frost Ward to restore mana to the mage, equal to 50% of the damage it absorbed. The talent was replaced by Frost Warding with the mage talent review in patch 1.11.0.
Improved Healing is a fourth tier priest talent in the holy tree. It reduces the mana cost of several priest healing spells.
Mana Burn is a priest discipline talent reducing the cast time for Mana Burn this is sought after for a disc pvp build.
Improved Renew is a Tier 1 Holy priest talent. It increases the amount of healing done by the Renew spell. The bonus is given after gear bonuses are applied.
Improved Feign Death is a hunter talent located on tier 4 of the Survival tree. It decreases the chance for Feign Death to be resisted.
Improved Rune Tap is a death knight talent located on tier 4 of the Blood tree.

Improved Icy Touch is a death knight talent located on tier 1 of the Frost tree. It is a requirement for taking Icy Talons deeper in the tree. On its own, the talent is primarily useful for tanks, although it has some use in player versus player combat too by slowing down your opponent. For a tank, the talent is valuable both because it increases the damage (and thus threat) caused by Icy Touch and because it increases the slowing effect of Frost Fever, which helps reduce incoming damage. Because of this, the talent is popular even with Blood and Unholy specced tanks.
Impurity is a death knight talent located on tier 5 of the Unholy tree.
Improved Flamestrike is a mage talent located on tier 3 of the Fire tree.
Improved Steady Shot is a hunter talent located on tier 2 of the Marksmanship tree.

Improved Flash Heal is a priest talent in the Discipline tree, available after spending 30 talent points. It reduces the mana cost of Flash Heal and its critical effect chance on targets at or below 50% health.

Improved Devouring Plague is a priest talent in the Shadow tree, available after spending 5 talent points. The talent causes Devouring Plague to instantly deal damage equal to 15/30% of its total periodic effect.

Improved Holy Concentration was a priest talent in the Holy tree, available after spending 3 talent points in Holy Concentration (priest talent) and 40 talent points in the Holy tree. It increased the chance to enter Holy Concentration and reduced the cast time of the next two Greater Heals, Flash Heals or Binding Heals for 20 sec. after you gained Holy Concentration.
Improved Blood Presence is a death knight talent in the Blood tree.
Improved Shadowform is a 35 point priest talent located in the 8th tier of the Shadow tree, available after spending one point in Shadowform. This increases the effectiveness of being in shadowform.
Improved Death Strike is a death knight talent in the Blood tree. Note that this talent will not increase the minimum limit healing.
Improved Inner Rage was a warrior talent that decreased Inner Rage (beta)'s cooldown up to 2 minutes.
Improved Kill Command is a hunter talent in the Beast Mastery tree.
Improved Blood Tap is a death knight talent in the Blood tree.
Improved Polymorph is an Arcane mage talent that causes Polymorph targets to be stunned for a few seconds if they are damaged while in the polymorph state.
Improved Icebound Fortitude is a level 75 Frost and Unholy death knight talent.
Improved Chaos Nova is a level 108 Havoc demon hunter talent.
Improved Scorpid Sting is a hunter talent, located on tier 5 of the Marksmanship tree.
Incineration is the Fire mage secondary stat attunement, focusing on Critical Strike.
Incinderella is a blood elf found in Molten Front as part of the Thrall's Thrashers in the raid section of the Firelands.
In For The Kill is a row 7 Arms warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Test of Might.
Indemnity is a Discipline priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Exaltation.

Infiltrator Minchar was a level 80 dwarf rogue that had a chance to appear inside Icecrown Citadel. In some cases, Minchar was waiting near the Oratory of the Damned, informing adventurers that Darnavan has been brainwashed by Lady Deathwhisper. In other cases, Alrin the Agile is waiting outside the Crimson Hall to inform adventurers that Minchar has been captured by Blood-Queen Lana'thel, who will execute him if he is not rescued soon.
Inert Soulbound Monstrosity is a wicker man located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Infernal Force is a vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Tormented Souls, Devour Souls, and Defensive Spikes traits.
Infernal Armor is an Azerite trait available to demon hunters.
Inertia is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Momentum.
Ingrys Stonebrow is a dwarf cloth armor vendor located at Maeva's Mystical Apparel in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.
Initiate's Shirt is the starting shirt for blood elf paladins.

Father Inigo Montoy was a human priest previously located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. He was affiliated with the Brotherhood of the Light and the Argent Dawn, though secretly was an agent of the Lich King and the Scourge.
Initiate Greer is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Initiate Vernon is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.

Initiate Mehrtens is a human vendor located on the top floor of Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra. She sells a Prototype Neural Needler that a player can buy to continue to torture the Imprisoned Beryl Sorcerer after completing The Art of Persuasion.
Initiate Park is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Initiate Knapp is a human located at Amber Ledge in the Borean Tundra.
Ingvar was a legendary vrykul warrior and the first and only Valarjar to wield the Warswords of the Valarjar. Odyn considered Ingvar to be his greatest champion.
Initiate Brenners is a human death knight found in the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
Initiate Gahark is an orc located at Death's Rise in Icecrown.
Initiate Roderick is a human located at Death's Rise in Icecrown.
Initiate's Vest is the starting chest for blood elf paladins.

Injured Night Elf Priestess is a night elf found at Azure Watch on Azuremyst Isle. Anchorite Fateema is taking care of her and asks the player to help her. She is involved in the following quests: *Medicinal Purpose *An Alternative Alternative
Ingrid Darkplait is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Ingrid Blackingot is a dwarf vendor located at the Stormshield in Ashran. She looks identical to Holly McTilla; amusingly, she wants to know where Holly gets her hair done.
Injured Bandit is a human located in the Hall of Shadows in Dalaran.
Injured Conjuror is a human located in the Hall of the Guardian in Dalaran.
Injured Ebon Knight is a human located at Acherus: The Ebon Hold in the Broken Isles.
Injured Shieldbearer is a human located in the Sanctum of Light at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Injured Hexpriest is a jungle troll priest located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Injured Sun Priest is a tauren priest located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Initiate Peony is a human located in Autumnvale in Drustvar.

Inge Ironfist is a dwarf that was part of an Alliance expedition sent to Silithus to study :Azerite and survey the Horde forces alongside Sentinel Cordressa Briarbow, Sapphronetta Flivvers, Gavvin Stoutarm and Arwis Blackstone. After the Horde attack on their camp, Cordressa was able to save the three dwarves and return them to Darnassus with valuable information.
Injured Drifter is a human located in Westfall during Legion Invasions.
Injured Alliance Soldier is a human located in Dustwallow Marsh.
Inflame is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Pyromaniac.
Innkeeper Firebrew is a dwarf innkeeper located in the Commons in Ironforge.
Innkeeper Grosk is an orc innkeeper located in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Innkeeper Belm is a dwarf innkeeper located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

Innkeeper Fredrik Farley is a human innkeeper located in Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He has a wife named Verina and daughter Anna. He is the brother of Frandis Farley. Falkhaan Isenstrider refers to him as his best friend.
Innkeeper Shaussiy was a night elf innkeeper located in Auberdine in Darkshore. She was possibly killed during the Cataclysm and no longer appears in-game.
Innkeeper Hearthstove is a dwarf innkeeper located in Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Innkeeper Heather is a human innkeeper located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
Innkeeper Helbrek is a dwarf innkeeper located in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Innkeeper Trelayne is a human innkeeper located in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Trelayne was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Innkeeper Anderson is a human innkeeper located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in the Cataclysm, Anderson's fate is unclear.
Innkeeper Thulbek is an orc innkeeper located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Innkeeper Karakul is an orc innkeeper located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Innkeeper Shul'kar is an orc innkeeper located in New Kargath in the Badlands.
Innkeeper Thulfram is a Wildhammer dwarf innkeeper located in Wildhammer Keep at Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
Innkeeper Grilka is an orc innkeeper located at Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.
Innkeeper Celeste Goodhutch is a human Innkeeper located inside Westguard Inn in Westguard Keep in the contested territory of the Howling Fjord. She and her husband run the inn.
Innkeeper Hazel Lagras is a human innkeeper located in her inn in the Alliance settlement of Valgarde in the Howling Fjord in Northrend. She also serves as a florist.

Inquisitor Hallard is a human located at Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. He is located in the cellar in the large keep where he is discussing (or at least attempting to) with Godfrey Goodard, a former ally of the Alliance but now one of the Scourge.

Innkeeper Monica is a human found in Old Hillsbrad Foothills, an instance located in the Caverns of Time. She is in Tarren Mill. She is also located in the same building in the present Tarren Mill as Monika Sengutz.
Innkeeper Corlin is the Wildhammer dwarf innkeeper of Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Linkasa is an orc innkeeper found at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.
Innkeeper Grak is an orc innkeeper found inside Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if he survived the Ironmarch.
Innkeeper Chin'toka is an orc innkeeper for the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. He also sells basic food and drink.
Innkeeper Wylaria is a night elf innkeeper located in Whisperwind Grove in Felwood.
Innkeeper Kerntis is an orc innkeeper at Grol'dom Farm in the Northern Barrens.
Innkeeper Daughny is a dwarf innkeeper located at the Swiftgear Station, in the Alliance-aligned zone of Wetlands.
Innkeeper Larisal is a night elf innkeeper located at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.
Innkeeper Keirnan is a Wildhammer dwarf innkeeper located in Wildhammer Keep at Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.
Innkeeper Francis is the dwarf innkeeper located at sea base of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Teresa is the human innkeeper located at sea base of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Lutz is an orc innkeeper located at Dragonmaw Port in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Krum is an orc innkeeper located at the Crushblow in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Turk is an orc innkeeper located at the Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Innkeeper Lhakadd is an orc innkeeper located at Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Ayriala is a night elf innkeeper located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Innkeeper Dessina is a night elf innkeeper located at the Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace.
Innkeeper Nufa is an orc innkeeper located at the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She owns the Wyvern's Tail inn.
Innkeeper Chall is an orc located in Throm'var in Frostfire Ridge.
Inquisitor Ward is a human located inside the cathedral at New Hearthglen in Dragonblight.
Inner Demons is a Havoc demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Deceiver's Fury trait.
Inquisitor Darkspeak is a human located in the Trade District of the Vision of Stormwind.
Insatiable Hunger is a Havoc demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Demon Blades.

Inquisitor Fairbell is a human of the Scarlet Crusade located in the Dawning Isles in Silverpine Forest when the crusaders attacked the Ruins of Lordaeron. When the Forsaken counterattacked them, Fairbell was seen escaping via a Scarlet Portal, accompanied by Crusader Alrick.
Interrogator James Vishas is a human found in the Scarlet Monastery Graveyard.

Intensify Rage is a warrior talent in the Fury tree, you will need to spend 22 points in Fury to max it. It reduces the cooldown of a number of warrior self buffs, all of which have to do with dealing more damage or gaining more rage.

Instructor Rufus is a Wildhammer dwarf located at The Headland in Hillsbrad Foothills. He is one of the three instructors training dwarves in combat. He was targeted by the Horde adventurers. During the Demon Invasions, he defended the area.
Instructor Nidriel is a night elf ghost located in Nar'thalas Academy in Azsuna.
Johnny Castle is a human located in Northrend Academy of Dance. He was taken out by the followers.
Instructor Alexander is a human located at the Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.
Instructor Teshal is a human located in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
Intangibility is a Shadow priest talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mental Fortitude.

Iomhar was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was the one who reported the deaths of Oengus and Tearlach to Kurdran. He and Farand also assisted Kurdran to battle the red dragons ridden by orcs that attacked the Third Fleet. While he apparently survived the war his status remains unknown.
Invoker Threadgold is a human mage of the Tirisgarde located in the Hall of the Guardian. He later appeared in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Investigator Vought is a human investigator from the SI:7 located in Dalaran. She was encountered by the Uncrowned champions.
Irene Sureshot is a dwarf gun vendor located at the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan.

Ipfelkofer Ironkeg is a dwarf in charge of the Brewfest Grounds outside of Ironforge. He'll explain anything you need to know about the event. Along with Tapper Swindlekeg, he can be found by a mole machine in the Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach.
Iron Thane Argrum is the ruler of Thor Modan in Grizzly Hills.

Iranis Shadebloom is a night elf profession trainer located in the inn of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. He teaches the apprentice level of all primary professions. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Irar was a member of the Council of Tirisfal 2,600 years before the First War. He battled against Kathra'natir who stole the Amulet of Waters.
Iron Horde Stowaway is an orc found next to some Stolen Treasure, a vignette, in Paletide Den in .
Iron Talons is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Fury of the Eagle (artifact trait), Hellcarver and Sharpened Fang traits.
Iron Guard Captain was an orc located in Gorgrond. He was killed by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.
Iron Backbreaker was an orc located in Blackrock Foundry. He was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Iron Heart is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the All-Consuming Rot, Blood Feast (artifact trait), Mouth of Hell, and Veinrender traits.
Iron Siegecaller is an orc located in Grom'gar in Frostfire Ridge. They are shouting the directions of Gentle Clefthooves for Iron Cannoneers to shot them with Iron Siege Cannons.
Iron Captain Argha is an orc located at Ironhold Harbor in Tanaan Jungle.
Iron Artilleryman is an orc riding Horgg in The Pit in Gorgrond.
Iron Horde Liaison is an orc located in Ironfist Harbor in .
Irigosa is a blue dragon located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken.
Irastrasza is a red dragon in night elf visage located in Algeth'ar Tower in Thaldraszus.

Ironormu is a bronze dragon in dwarf visage called Ironus Coldsteel. He is a blacksmithing trainer located near the Great Anvil at the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. In World of Warcraft: Classic, he's a weaponsmithing trainer. After completing his quests in Thaldraszus, he will sell a number of weaponsmithing recipes that had previously been removed.

Ironpatch is an orc member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers found in Cape of Stranglethorn on board The Crimson Veil. He is in charge of the guns and cannons. When the adventurer infiltrated the Bloodsail Buccaneers, Ironpatch tasked them with using the cannons to decimate the Venture Company goblin drilling for oil to the north.
Ironforge Brigade Footman is a dwarf found in Silithus. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, his corpse could be found after Sargeras's destruction of the region.
Ironhoof is an aged tauren warrior and member of the Garad'kra. He longs to prove he is still strong and an asset to both the tauren people and the Horde.
Ironforge Brigade Rifleman is a dwarf found in Silithus. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, his corpse could be found after Sargeras's destruction of the region.

Iskar was an orc from the Warsong clan and the advisor to Grommash Hellscream some time before the Third War. He oversaw Thrall's tests to decide if he would receive an audience with Grom. First, Thrall had to beat three of the clan's finest warriors, and Iskar was pleased when Thrall spared them. However, his next test required Thrall to kill a human child who the clan had captured earlier, which Thrall refused. Iskar prepared to set the clan's warriors on Thrall when Hellscream intervened. He reprimanded Iskar for allowing the capture of a child who could be tracked back to them. He also waved away Iskar's concerns at Thrall's reluctance to kill, pointing out that senseless bloodshed had n
Isirami Fairwind is a high elf and is the main innkeeper of the alliance inn A Hero's Welcome which is found in Dalaran. Players who talk to her during Hallow's End can receive a trick or treat.

Iskalder is a mjordin vrykul hero, initially slumbering in the Halls of the Ancestors in Icecrown and rumored to be the greatest vrykul hero ever. The Bone Witch directs you to wake him and use an amulet to subjugate his will and return him to her. She then has you use Iskalder (possessed) to draw Vardmadra to a battle, in order to possess her.

Isilra is a blood elf and the lover of Ashra Valandril. Isilra's father apparently disapproves of the relationship, forcing her and Ashra to meet in secret. She believes that Ashra is torn between his love for her and his love for the Light, though Ashra himself denies it. After the Cataclysm, Ashra was sent to join the Garad'kra militia in Kalimdor, but he promised Isilra that he would return home to her soon. Isilra gave him a handmade cord to remember her by.
Irriende is a Highborne night elf mage trainer located at Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Isabella Jean is a human located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Isteth was a night elf who sought out Illidan Stormrage in Outland to fight the Burning Legion. She had lost all three of her children to the Legion during the Third War, and carried her baby's corpse across her chest. She would frequently scream throughout the night, and once killed a blood elf who tried to silence her. After undergoing the rites to become a demon hunter, she threw herself from the battlements of Karabor out of horror at what she had become.
Israen was a member of the Kirin Tor who set out to find the destructive staff called :Light's Wrath.
It's Cold Outside is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Jouster trait.
Isarian Shadowplume is a void elf inscription trainer located inside a tower in the Crumbling Life Archway in the Waking Shores.
Isabela Andare is a human located in Three-Falls Lookout in the Azure Span.
Iskakx is a proto-dragon located in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Jack Sterling is a human located in Everlook in Winterspring.

Itharius's Cave is the current residence of the mysterious high elf Itharius. It is located in the far southwestern corner of the Swamp of Sorrows. The area outside the cave is filled with unruly green whelps, which Itharius has taken it upon himself to watch over while they grow.

Jack was a poor human farmer near Southshore that joined the Cult of the Damned. When a trio of knights rode by his farm, Jack invited them in and provided them hospitality that they hadn't experienced in a long time. Jack listened when they discussed their current plans on where they were heading. Afterwards, Jack murdered the knights by poisoning their stew. He reported what he had learned to the Cult of the Damned, who advised him to leave Southshore for his own safety. Jack sold his farm and chartered a boat to Northrend.
Jack Adams is a human pirate found on Scalawag Point in Howling Fjord. He seems to have a love for alcohol.
Jack Rockleg is a Thorium Brotherhood member located at Thorium Advance in the Searing Gorge.
Ja'ara is a night elf Watcher. She was sent by Maiev Shadowsong to remove an evidence of murdered Sentinels in Darnassus.

Jackson Bajheera is a human captain of the Alliance, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Bajheera or another random Alliance Captain will spawn each time the Alliance reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Iven Page is a human located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Ix'dreloth is a fel lord located at the Legion Invasion locations.
Jace Bellcamp is a human priest located at Deliverance Point in the Broken Shore.
Jacqueline Sage is a human warrior located in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.
Jackson Watkins is a human located in the Hall of the Guardian.
Jacob Davis is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

Ivagont was a vrykul priest who laid waste to Stormscale naga villages with his friend Kakushan in Darkshore. They drank the blood of their enemies and crafted armor from their skins. By virtue of Ivagont's protection, the two remained unscathed.
Jack McWeaksauce is a human who provided equipment on the PTR.
Ithanil Shadowlash was a night elf druid found in Grizzleweald in Val'sharah. He asked to cleanse Oakleaf from the Emerald Nightmare, spawning the Darkest Fear.

Jailor Kassan was one of Garithos' underlings, a dedicated man in command of the Dalaran prisons. A former friend of Kael'thas and servant to the Kirin Tor, he was forced to oversee the imprisonment of the blood elves for consorting with the naga. Upon meeting face to face Kassan remarked that it was always a pity to see a wizard go bad and was shown to be reluctant to have to attack the Prince. However upon being informed by the Prince that the blood elves would be leaving one way or another, Kassan merely told him "Do what you have to do". The two then departed with both leaders rallying their forces for the battle ahead. Jailor Kassan would put up a valiant fight, calling in reinforcement
Jaelysia is a night elf stable master located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.

Jailor Marlgen was a level 24 human found in Durnholde Keep in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He carried the key needed to free Tog'thar. Curiously, although he was an obvious member of the Syndicate (complete with orange bandana), killing him neither decreased your Syndicate reputation nor increased your Ravenholdt reputation.
Jailor Eston is a human found in Durnholde Keep in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He carried the key needed to free Drull.

Jalia was an elder, full-bodied stout woman who had given birth to six children, and midwifed several times that number. She was a resident of a town near Dalaran where Rhonin and Vereesa Windrunner had settled down, and assisted the then-pregnant high elf through her maternity. Rhonin was certain that a human would be leery of dealing with an elf, but Jalia did not have any problem with helping Vereesa. She continued to take care of the twins afterwards and was like a grandmother and second mother to them. Her status is unknown, but it is possible that she still watches over the boys in Dalaran.

Jaeson is a young human, he is an inexperienced guide and tracker. He comes from a family of simple farmers living near Dalaran. He is a friend and companion to the dwarf Rogthur. They were supposed to find out whom a group of Forsaken scouts were meeting up with, but instead they found only their remains being looted by forest trolls.

Jai'nor was a high elf mage who had been captured to fight in the gladiatorial games in Stranglethorn Vale's Gurubashi Arena. He suffered from withdrawal and needed his spellbook. He was somewhat useful to a group of escaped prisoners after they convinced him to join them, but only after his spellbook was retrieved.
James Deacon is a human innkeeper of the Valiant Rest, at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Jamai is a jungle troll hunter trainer located at Sen'jin Village in Durotar. She switches between standing in the northwestern hut and speaking with Hai'zan, the butcher.
Jade Ramalot is a dwarf weaponsmith located in Ironforge Airfield in the dwarven starting zone of Dun Morogh.

Jalod is a soldier under Lorena. He was an old soldier who had fought against orcs before anyone in Lordaeron knew of them and was rumored to have trained Admiral Proudmoore, which Lorena doubted. Jalod accompanied Lorena and her army out of Northwatch. They were attacked by orcish members of the Burning Blade clan. He was amongst uninjured soldiers. It is unknown whether he survived the destruction of Northwatch and Theramore.
Jahi is a general goods vendor located west of Ramkahen in Uldum. He appears in the Vision of the Twisting Sands.
Jade Mists is the Mistweaver monk secondary stat attunement, focusing on Multistrike. It also improves Renewing Mist and Rising Sun Kick.
James Lamone is a human blacksmithing vendor located at the Khadgar's Tower in Talador.
Jaiden Trask is a human found outside Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Jagganath is a skeletal orc located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak.
Jagged Spikes is a Vengeance demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.

Jakhar is a troll priest who accompanied the Horde Expedition to Northrend during the war against the Lich King and who came into possession of the staff known as :Light's Wrath. Aboard a zeppelin en route to the warfront, Jakhar practiced wielding Light's Wrath and dreamed of smiting the forces of the Undead Scourge. Over Northrend, the zeppelin was knocked out of the sky by a fierce storm and crash landed deep within Scourge territory, forcing Jakhar to use Light's Wrath to decimate the Scourge and help the Horde soldiers fight their way to safety. During the war in Northrend, Jakhar used Light's Wrath to purify the land of undead wherever she went, earning her high praise from the Horde's
James Comerford is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Jaela Billman is a human located in the Curious Octopus in Boralus.
Jake Howard is a human located in Boralus where he walks between Tradewinds Market and Boralus Harbor.
Jake Storm is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar. He is also present during Faction Assault on Drustvar.
James Ashvane was a member of House Ashvane. A memorial in his honor is located in Unity Square in Boralus.

Jaggal is a gnoll and the temporal leader of the Woodpaw clan. The Gordunni ogres' actions in Feralas drove the Woodpaw into conflict with the Feral Scar yetis, who were also been driven east by the deforestation. The conflicts resulted in the deaths of their two previous matriarchs and brutes. As such, they no longer had a matriarch to lead them, so Jaggal the brute proclaimed himself to decide for the Woodpaw. He hopes that his daughter Sivet will become the new matriarch.
Jaelora is a void elf found with Yolvana at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus.
Jansen Underwood is a human blacksmithing vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Jase Farlane is a human trade goods vendor located at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

Jandice Barov is a human ghost mini-boss found in Scholomance. She is a member of the ill-fated Barov family. The lever (Torch) to access Scholomance's Old Treasure Chest is found near Jandice, in the south side of the basement.

Janela Stouthammer is a dwarf located at the Hive'Zora Alliance camp in Silithus. She was involved in the Field Duty quest line. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, her corpse could be found after Sargeras's destruction of the region.
Jaquilina Dramet is a human axe vendor located at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
Jeena Featherbow is a night elf bow vendor located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Jen'shan is a jungle troll hunter trainer located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar. She was replaced by Karranisha in the Cataclysm.

Jark is an orc general goods vendor located in the Razor Hill Barracks in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he was found at the Razor Hill Outskirts. During the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill, he was located by the forge.
Jarven Thunderbrew is a dwarf located downstairs in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

Janos Hammerknuckle is a human weaponsmith located in Northshire Valley Elwynn Forest. He can be found beside his wagon near the entrance to Northshire Abbey. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Jorik remained at his usual spot and was seen fighting a Confused Recruit.

Jayla was a night elf artisan skinning trainer located at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. She was killed when the Horde conquered the region: her body can be found on the road to the west of the Refuge, where she was probably murdered while trying to flee to Astranaar.

Jazzik is a goblin general goods vendor located in Ratchet of Northern Barrens. He maintains his store, Jazzik's General Goods, along with Ranik, a trade goods supplier. He carries a red bag. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Janet Hommers is a human drink and fungus vendor located in Nijel's Point in Desolace. She is of the Stormwind faction.

Jed Runewatcher is a rare spawn orc in Upper Blackrock Spire. He may wander in the room of Goraluk Anvilcrack or in the Furnace (near The Beast). It is possible to use the /target command from the entrance of Blackrock Spire to check whether he is spawned Goraluk Anvilcrack's room, but you must be past Blackrock Stadium (where you fight Rend Blackhand before /target will work if he is spawned in the Furnace. He's a member of the Blackhand Legion.

Jaysin Lanyda is a human reagent and poison vendor located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of Southshore by Forsaken plague bombing in Cataclysm, Jaysin's fate is unclear.

Janice Felstone is a human ghost located at the Felstone Field farm in the Western Plaguelands. She would occasionally scream out for help. She was the sister of Jeremiah Felstone, who is now also undead and has changed his name to Jeremiah Payson. She was also the sister of Emma Felstone, who lives in Stormwind and goes by the name Ol' Emma. Janice was married to a "John" before they became undead. She asked adventurers (thinking they were John) to bring her John's part of the charm. The charm dropped off of the Jabbering Ghoul, a ghoul that carried a pitchfork, revealing that John too had indeed succumbed to the Scourge. The ghost of Janice Felstone vanished since the cleansing of the Plag
Jan'alai is the Amani lord of dragonhawks. He is one of the four animal bosses in the Zul'Aman instance. He is guarding the cage containing the orc male, Kraz as part of the Zul'Aman Timed Event
Jason Mathers is a human fisherman found in Elwynn Forest. He can be found at a small pier with Lee Brown near the house of Adele Fielder, on the north-western shore of Crystal Lake.
